text: 28 August 2026
translated: 28 August 2026

text: The Simplicity example in Options no longer shows a line the game does not print.
translated: The Simplicity example in 选项 no longer shows a line the game does not print.

text: The beast's plate no longer shoves the panel beside it as fights start and end.
translated: The 野兽's plate no longer shoves the panel beside it as fights start and end.

text: The “turn sound on” prompt no longer returns for every adventurer. It asks once, after your first boss.
translated: The “turn sound on” prompt no longer returns for every adventurer. It asks once, after your first 首领.

text: “Send for this one now” now works with a full party. The yard asks which hand steps down, and that hand keeps its study.
translated: “Send for this one now” now works with a full party. The yard asks which hand steps down, and that hand keeps its study.

text: The off-hand feat is now read by every fitting, so Auto-equip no longer strips your second weapon for a shield.
translated: The off-hand feat is now read by every fitting, so Auto-equip no longer strips your second weapon for a 盾牌.

text: The Armoury now hands over the second weapon, and toggling the off-hand feat re-fits your kit on the spot
translated: 军械库 now hands over the second weapon, and toggling the off-hand feat re-fits your kit on the spot

text: The Red Hour wrote to the log many times a second. It writes once now.
translated: The Red Hour wrote to the log many times a second. It writes once now.

text: With Simple wording on, the school tooltip promised spell names and never showed them.
translated: With Simple wording on, the school tooltip promised 法术 names and never showed them.

text: The ability row slid under the header when you scrolled the list. It stays in place now.
translated: The 能力 row slid under the header when you scrolled the list. It stays in place now.

text: When two spells were tied, the wrong one sat on top. The firing one sits on top now.
translated: When two spells were tied, the wrong one sat on top. The firing one sits on top now.

text: Clearing the wall before v1.6.2 never gave “The Hand That Walked Out”. It does now.
translated: Clearing the wall before v1.6.2 never gave “The Hand That Walked Out”. It does now.

text: Four set accessories had no description in the armoury book. They show their bonus now.
translated: Four set accessories had no description in the armoury book. They show their bonus now.

text: Single-source items now say “and no other way” instead of “and off no other door”.
translated: Single-source items now say “and no other way” instead of “and off no other door”.

text: 25 August 2026
translated: 25 August 2026

text: The four new pets could not eat. Now they eat.
translated: The four new pets could not eat. Now they eat.

text: Vane still doubles the chance.
translated: 维恩 still doubles the chance.

text: The cave-shrike, road-mole, magpie and mist-hare ate nothing and never grew.
translated: The 洞穴尖啸鸟, 道路鼹鼠, magpie and 雾兔 ate nothing and never grew.

text: Pets already on your Roll start growing from the next stroke, leg or chest.
translated: 宠物 already on your Roll start growing from the next stroke, leg or chest.

text: A pet's door now opens the moment it is earned, instead of at the next kill.
translated: A pet's door now opens the moment it is earned, instead of at the next kill.

text: A fully grown mist-hare shows a full bar at its tenth growth, which is its cap.
translated: A fully grown 雾兔 shows a full bar at its tenth growth, which is its cap.

text: A fast chronicle spent seconds on road legs and earned almost no descent for them.
translated: A fast chronicle spent seconds on 道路路段 and earned almost no descent for them.

text: 24 August 2026
translated: 24 August 2026

text: New items, pets, a hireling, and a folk and an origin to unlock. Details on Steam.

text: Every folk, trade and origin gift is lifted. Details on Steam.
translated: Every 种族, 职业 and 出身 gift is lifted. Details on Steam.

translated: The Infirmary's stay is capped at two and a half minutes, was ten, and a camp is made below half your 生命值, was a quarter.

translated: The 骨犬 pays +2 max 生命值 a growth, was +1.
